title: multi-session-dev lane result
description: Structured output every lane session must return. Strict (additionalProperties=false, all keys required) so both Claude --json-schema and Codex --output-schema accept it.

status.description: complete: acceptance met and evidence attached. blocked: needs an approval or input the lane contract did not grant. failed: attempted and could not finish.

scope.description: What this lane actually covered, in one or two sentences.

files.description: Repo-relative paths changed (write lane) or reviewed (read lane).

evidence.description: Verification commands actually run and their observed results.

risks.description: Remaining risks, unverified assumptions, or out-of-scope findings.

handoff.description: What the Lead should do next with this lane's output.

verdict.description: Review lanes only. Implementation lanes return N/A.

blocked_reason.description: Required approval or missing input when status is blocked; empty string otherwise.
